purpose: Non-windowed verification of Rust workspace/profile text-action geometry/input and batched Metal integration; GUI and performance acceptance deferred

build_input_snapshot.method: Committed staging/build/bootstrap source archive plus listed UI overrides; concurrent network-policy edits excluded.
build_input_snapshot.python_scope: Current workspace suite includes two concurrent overlay/staging tests, excluded from this UI commit.

build_consistency: final Ninja dry run reported no work to do

deferred_gui_matrix.note: Matching backend and isolated browser fixture required. Listing/compilation is not execution.

unit_verified_mechanisms: Button metrics retain supplied platform horizontal padding, minimum width and control height; zero/tiny/negative/saturated metrics produce bounded text regions.

Vertical groups preserve full width, spacing and extent; horizontal groups preserve natural widths and center heights, proportionally shrink insufficient width and stay bounded with large integer metrics.

Text-action primitives preserve centered Unicode text, backing, hover overlay, pill radius, optional stroked border and focus feedback. Text-only style omits transparent backing/border; an empty label emits no spurious ink rectangle.
Existing Rust pointer/key, form validation, selection/notice, appearance and layout tests continue to pass with the new action geometry/recipe.
implemented_pending_runtime_verification: Nine workspace/profile actions use SceneTextButton nodes without native MdTextButton/Labels, batched into four SceneActionGroup Metal canvases. Legacy Views retains MdTextButton controls and original gaps.

Platform typography/metric/color services supply font measurement, control height, padding/minimum width, foreground/backing/border/hover/disabled/prominent colors. Rust owns button/group placement and the ordinary text-action drawing recipe; no shader/quad ABI change.

SceneTextButton reuses SceneGlyphButton native event/focus/AX adapters and Rust pointer/key reducer, with native focus ring/click ink/state animation drawing disabled. Mac Space uses existing key-down policy; Return remains available to default handling.

Caption changes cancel pending input and update AX names/tooltips/metrics; workspace/profile selection/catalogue/reopening and group visibility cancel armed gestures. Weak invalidation updates canvases independently of native rasterization; unchanged scene fingerprints skip GPU work.

Native fallback consumes the same display list. Native command services retain profile/workspace allocation, isolation, beforeunload and persistence. Accepted admission remains distinct from durable storage completion.

The browser-test FindButton helper now also matches non-Md native Button AX names. The new compiled case covers group scene text, absence of native Labels/focus rings, dynamic create/delete captions, cancelled targets, mouse/Space, validation and real profile deletion. It has not run.
deferred_checkpoint: Run all 59 Metal cases and 27 Views controls, including new form-action regression and existing profile/workspace lifecycle, appearance, validation and failed-write cases.
Recheck curated browser-test button resolution after generic AX-name lookup was added; do not infer pass from compilation.

Inspect actual platform font/CoreText regular-medium glyph output, ellipsis, default/prominent/text/disabled colors, hover/focus/keyboard/AX, narrow widths, clipping, theme/scale and GPU/native fallback.
Verify dynamic captions, pending/cancelled/disabled actions, profile catalogue/selection and workspace changes, hidden/restored groups, native editing/IME and modal default behavior.
Verify profile/session isolation, beforeunload, service rejection/retry and durable configuration restore; package/sign and inspect the matching isolated app.
Measure real CPU/GPU/actual presentation against Views separately. No latency or speedup is established by unit durations, compilation or canvas counts.
limitations: No app or browser/desktop window was launched. Native typography/colors/input, actual Metal presentation and persistence remain unaccepted.
Native Button/AX/focus/input nodes, editors/pickers, header/outer panel/modal hosts and other Views surfaces remain. Full migration is incomplete.
No shader/quad ABI, crate, framework or binary dependency was added. Existing original-code Apache-2.0 and upstream notices remain.
